subject: Integration studio: scheduling hands-on routing & load test session
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah@orionanalytics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jmills@orionanalytics.com>, ops+poc@orionanalytics.com
Date: 2027-02-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Hands-on session — routing / load test availability

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team at Orion found the routing examples very helpful. We'd like to move to a hands-on integration studio: a 90m session where we can do prompt walkthroughs, run a small routing policy exercise (model selection + fallback), and a lightweight load test to validate latency under our expected traffic shape.

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood run a short 1000-token per-second simulation for ~10 minutes against a pinned model (we can provide sample traces)?
- We'd like to review the fallback config you recommend for our multi-region setup.

Preferred week: Feb 15–19 (US PST mornings). If those don't work, Feb 22–26 is okay.

Attaching a rough list of attendee roles and desired outcomes.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Park
Director of AI Ops — Orion Analytics
Attachments: orion-attendees.csv
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on session — routing / load test availability

Hi Sarah — great to hear. We can absolutely run a short simulation and walk through routing fallbacks. Proposed plan (high level):

1) 15m — quick intros + goals
2) 25m — prompt review & model selection (recommendation between rdx-small-8q and rdx-bert-16 for your conversational routing)
3) 30m — routing policy workshop (rules, regional tiering, and automatic fallbacks)
4) 20m — controlled load run + review of latencies and tail behavior

Options for session slots (PST mornings):
- Tue Feb 16 — 09:00–10:30
- Wed Feb 17 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu Feb 18 — 09:30–11:00

Ben will own the load test config and Vivek will lead the routing policy recommendations. Can you confirm attendees and which model families you want us to include for the workshop? Also, please upload a 2–3 minute representative trace (or we can use the sample traces you attached).

I'll attach a short agenda and a template loadtest spec.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: poc-agenda.pdf, loadtest-params.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-08T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hands-on session — routing / load test availability

Folks — quick operational notes from the infra side:
- For a 10-minute 1k TPS burst we should run against a dedicated small pool (reserved) to avoid noisy neighbors; that will give stable latency numbers.
- If Orion wants quantized model variants, we should include an rdx-small-8q path and an rdx-small-16fp baseline so we can show tradeoffs.
- Need the sample trace at least 48h before the run so I can stage a warmed KV cache snapshot.

I'll prepare two load profiles: a steady 1k TPS and a 10m ramp-to-1k spike. If the customer wants more realistic interleaving (chat + embeddings), flag that early.

Ben
Lead Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference

To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jmills@orionanalytics.com>, ops+poc@orionanalytics.com

Thanks — that all makes sense. We prefer Tue Feb 16 09:00 PST. Attendees (confirmed): Jordan Mills (platform), Sarah Park (AI Ops), Priya Bose (data).

Model preference: include both rdx-small-8q and rdx-small-16fp. We'll upload two sample traces (chat_trace_short.json and batch_trace.csv) to the Drive folder you shared by EOD Feb 10.

One ask on routing: we have traffic in us-west and eu-west and want a fallback that keeps EU traffic in-region if latencies are within 120ms; otherwise fail over to US. Can you include that in the workshop?

Best,
Sarah
